🇲🇽🏭 INVERSIÓN FIJA −3.1% ANUAL EN MARZO — 19 MESES SEGUIDOS. EL FREEZE ES EL TMEC, NO LA 4T

INEGI: gross fixed investment fell 3.1% annual in March 2026 — 19 consecutive months down, longest streak since 2018-2021. El Financiero, Bloomberg and Banco Base all name the same cause: T-MEC review uncertainty and Trump's Section 232 tariff threats freezing private capex. Yet on the monthly print investment rose 0.4% and private consumption climbed 1.2% — the Mexican economy is absorbing the trade-war shock without breaking. Plan México deploys 5.6 trillion pesos in public infrastructure across the sexenio, 722 billion in 2026 alone. While private capital waits to see if Trump blinks at the June 16 TMEC round, the State keeps building.

🚨🇲🇽 TRUMP RESUMES FAMILY SEPARATION — DOZENS OF MIGRANT KIDS TORN FROM PARENTS DESPITE 2031 COURT BAN

An AP investigation confirms the Trump administration has separated dozens of migrant children from their parents in his second term — directly defying a federal court agreement prohibiting most family separations until December 2031. Some parents detained for months in ICE camps; others deported alone, leaving US-citizen children behind. La Jornada's June 5 follow-up documents one child, Ederson, separated twice from his mother. Human rights groups call it "lasting, devastating harm." The cruelty was the policy in 2018. It's the policy again — just hidden inside the mass-deportation machinery.

🔥🇲🇽 MORENA LAUNCHES 2,600 ASSEMBLIES AGAINST ULTRADERECHA MEDIA WAR — ONE PER MUNICIPALITY, JUNE–AUGUST

National leader Ariadna Montiel announced 2,600 informational assemblies across the country through June, July and August — at least one per municipality, with larger zones like Ecatepec split by electoral district. "The PAN wants to construct a narrative that the Mexican Government or the Cuarta Transformación movement has ties to drug trafficking," Montiel said, "when in fact only PAN administrations have had actual organized-crime links." The mobilization answers Sheinbaum's May 31 call to occupy public plazas against foreign-backed interference. The 4T doesn't fight propaganda with hashtags — it fights it with organized people in plazas.

🔥🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM: "WHO GOVERNS MEXICO — FOREIGN INSTITUTIONS OR MEXICAN ONES?"

The president named the offensive plain: "external interests threaten the power of the people; that's what's in dispute." She told the opposition what really upsets them: "the separation between political power and economic power." The June 3 DOF reforms — modifying judicial election, building a candidate integrity check, and codifying foreign intervention as grounds for electoral nullity — are now constitutional law. The campaign labeling Mexico a "narco-state" comes from the same operators who lost privileges in 2018, now coordinated with US far-right networks and DOJ pressure. The fight isn't about Sheinbaum personally. It's about who decides Mexico.

🚨🇲🇽 ICE GRABS AYOTZINAPA FUGITIVE IN CALIFORNIA — 12 YEARS AFTER THE 43 DISAPPEARED

ICE Los Angeles arrested Enrique Martínez Chávez, 32, in Hawthorne — a former soldier of the 27th Infantry Battalion on duty the night of September 26, 2014, when municipal police, military and federal forces attacked Ayotzinapa students in Iguala. He's one of 16 military personnel ordered arrested by a federal judge in June 2023 for forced disappearance. ICE confirmed he'll remain in custody pending transfer to Mexico. The 4T's truth-and-justice work on the 43 keeps closing on the perpetrators — even the ones who fled north thinking the US would shelter them.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 TRUMP TREASURY SANCTIONS DÍAZ-CANEL, RAÚL CASTRO'S FAMILY — "IMPERIAL OFFENSIVE WILL FAIL"

Treasury blacklisted Cuba's president Miguel Díaz-Canel, first lady Lis Cuesta, Raúl Castro's son Alejandro Castro Espín, his grandson Raúl Alejandro Castro Calís, plus the Revolutionary Armed Forces and the Committees for the Defense of the Revolution. Rubio justified it calling Havana "capital of radical left terrorism for nearly seven decades." Díaz-Canel: "the aggression and perversity of the Yankee government will crash against our decision to face the worst scenarios and resist the imperial offensive." Three months after Trump said he'd "take Cuba almost immediately" — and Cuba still hasn't blinked.

🇲🇽📊 <u>POBREZA LABORAL CAE A 30.7% — MÍNIMO EN 21 AÑOS, 3.9 MILLONES DE MEXICANOS SALEN EN UN AÑO</u>

INEGI's Q1 2026 release: labor poverty dropped from 33.9% to 30.7% year-over-year — the lowest in 21 years of records (series began 2005). 3.9 million Mexicans climbed out of labor poverty in 12 months. Real per-capita labor income rose 7.4% YoY (from 3,402.79 to 3,653 pesos/month). Rural fell 3.8 ppt to 44.2%; urban 2.8 ppt to 26.9%.

El Financiero today (June 4): "El escenario que está ocurriendo es uno de crecimiento intensivo en lugar de extensivo: el mercado laboral no está expandiéndose rápido en número de empleos, pero los puestos existentes están pagando mejor en términos reales." Translation: same jobs, paying more in real terms. The "estancamiento" panic narrative is private-sector business federations' noise. The minimum-wage hikes — doubled under AMLO, continuing under Sheinbaum — are reaching households. Hard INEGI data, not opinion.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>ISRAEL KILLS 9 IN LEBANON IN 24 HOURS — STRIKE "SPECIFICALLY TARGETED AN AMBULANCE" AS APRIL CEASEFIRE COLLAPSES</u>

Israeli airstrikes killed 9 in Lebanon over the past day, including a Lebanese army soldier traveling on a southern road and two more wounded in Khaldeh just south of Beirut. Lebanon's Ministry of Public Health reported one strike was "directed specifically against an ambulance."

Since the March 2 escalation: 3,516 dead and 10,674 wounded in a country that signed a US-mediated ceasefire in mid-April. Hezbollah responded with rocket launches against Israeli soldiers in northern Israel. The "ceasefire" exists on paper for the cameras; the killing never stopped. Same playbook the empire ran on Gaza, now exported north.

🇲🇽⚽ <u>MUNDIAL 2026 LEAVES 4,208 COMMUNITY FIELDS AND 1.13 MILLION KIDS PLAYING — NOT JUST 16 STADIUM MATCHES</u>

Coordinator Gabriela Cuevas detailed the "Mundial Social" legacy today: 4,208 sports fields built or rehabilitated nationwide; 1.13 million students competing in the Mundial Escolar with 43% female participation (over 490,000 girls and young women); 59,253 athletes across 2,963 teams in the Copa Conade; 7,000+ community murals; 64 fields rehabbed by IMSS in 39 municipalities; 400 million pesos restoring 46 archaeological zones, 15 museums and 12 prehispanic ball courts.

"Lo que nos interesa enormemente es que el Mundial no sean solo los partidos que se juegan en México y se vayan" — Cuevas. FIFA has never seen a host build public infrastructure like this. The 4T turns a tournament into permanent community capital.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM LAUNCHES "DERECHO DE RÉPLICA" — A STATE-RUN FACT-CHECK ON BLACK PROPAGANDA</u>

Luisa María Alcalde (Consejería Jurídica de la Presidencia) launched the platform today — a federal space to publicly correct mainstream-media disinformation. First edition exposed a fabricated "35% economic contraction in Sinaloa" headline. Real figure: +4.2% growth.

That single lie tracked 18,000 mentions across 7,000 unique accounts with 4.2 million potential reach in one cycle. "Los medios de comunicación están obligados a difundir la réplica en las mismas condiciones" — Alcalde, citing the law. The opposition has had the megaphone for thirty years. The information war just became bilateral.
